metadata.title: Fitness OS Phase 15 Body Progress, Dashboard and Analytics Reference Data
metadata.notice: This file defines metric contracts, measurement protocols, dashboard widgets, data-quality flags and draft knowledge identities. It contains no user measurements, photos or inferred health conclusions.

stores.purpose: Sanitized local image binaries; excluded from default JSON backup.
User-declared completeness status for nutrition analytics.
Units, date ranges, privacy and display settings.
Edits, imports, deletes and photo operations.
Rebuildable derived metrics; excluded from canonical backup.

measurementProtocols.title: Body weight - consistent personal protocol
measurementProtocols.summary: Record scale, time context, clothing and measurement conditions; compare repeated measurements using the same setup.

measurementProtocols.title: Standing height
measurementProtocols.summary: Record measured standing height, measurement date and method. Height is not inferred from user profile text.

measurementProtocols.title: Waist - WHO midpoint
measurementProtocols.summary: Horizontal measurement near the midpoint between the last palpable rib and top of iliac crest; store breathing phase and protocol version.

measurementProtocols.title: Waist - superior iliac crest
measurementProtocols.summary: Distinct protocol. Never merge automatically with WHO midpoint or umbilical waist records.

measurementProtocols.title: Waist - umbilical level
measurementProtocols.summary: Personal tracking site only. Keep separate from WHO and NHANES-style protocols.

measurementProtocols.title: Hip - maximum circumference
measurementProtocols.summary: Horizontal circumference at the maximum buttock extension; store posture and tape method.

measurementProtocols.title: Chest - relaxed
measurementProtocols.summary: User-defined landmark and breathing phase must remain consistent.

measurementProtocols.title: Chest - inspired
measurementProtocols.summary: Separate from relaxed chest measurements.

measurementProtocols.title: Upper arm - relaxed
measurementProtocols.summary: Store left or right side and landmark.

measurementProtocols.title: Upper arm - flexed
measurementProtocols.summary: Store side, pose and landmark; never merge with relaxed arm.

measurementProtocols.title: Forearm - maximum circumference
measurementProtocols.summary: Store side and landmark.

measurementProtocols.title: Thigh - midpoint
measurementProtocols.summary: Store side and exact midpoint definition.

measurementProtocols.title: Thigh - maximum circumference
measurementProtocols.summary: Distinct from midpoint thigh.

measurementProtocols.title: Calf - maximum circumference
measurementProtocols.summary: Store side and posture.

measurementProtocols.title: Neck circumference
measurementProtocols.summary: Store landmark and head position; educational tracking only.

measurementProtocols.title: Skinfold assessment - external result
measurementProtocols.summary: Store the reported result and protocol; the application does not calculate body fat from skinfolds.

measurementProtocols.title: Bioelectrical impedance - external result
measurementProtocols.summary: Store device, model, software, conditions and reported estimates; do not merge across devices by default.

measurementProtocols.title: DXA - external report
measurementProtocols.summary: Store facility, device, software and report date; values are user-entered from the report.

measurementProtocols.title: Air displacement plethysmography - external result
measurementProtocols.summary: Store device and protocol metadata.

measurementProtocols.title: Hydrostatic weighing - external result
measurementProtocols.summary: Store laboratory and protocol metadata.

measurementProtocols.title: Ultrasound body composition - external result
measurementProtocols.summary: Store operator, device and measurement site metadata.

measurementProtocols.title: 3D optical estimate - external result
measurementProtocols.summary: Store device and software version; label as an estimate.

metricDefinitions.label: Daily weight
metricDefinitions.formula: Median of all non-deleted weight records for one local date after conversion to kilograms.
qualityRules: Do not delete possible outliers automatically

metricDefinitions.label: 7-day weight trend
metricDefinitions.formula: Arithmetic mean of available daily medians in the trailing 7 local dates.

metricDefinitions.label: 28-day weight trend
metricDefinitions.formula: Arithmetic mean of available daily medians in the trailing 28 local dates.

metricDefinitions.label: Weekly trend change
metricDefinitions.formula: Latest complete or qualifying 7-day mean minus the immediately preceding qualifying 7-day mean.
qualityRules: Each 7-day window requires at least 3 measured days

metricDefinitions.label: Circumference change
metricDefinitions.formula: Latest canonical session value minus selected baseline session value for the same site, protocol version, side and posture.

metricDefinitions.label: Body-composition estimate change
metricDefinitions.formula: Latest value minus baseline only when method, device/model and protocol compatibility rules pass.
qualityRules: Do not merge methods by default

metricDefinitions.label: Completed workout sessions
metricDefinitions.formula: Count of non-deleted Phase 06 sessions with status completed in the selected date range.
qualityRules: Date range uses session local date

metricDefinitions.label: Workout duration
metricDefinitions.formula: Sum or median of completed-session active duration according to the selected view.

metricDefinitions.label: Completed sets
metricDefinitions.formula: Count completed sets after applying visible set-type filters.
qualityRules: Default excludes warm-up and technique sets

metricDefinitions.label: Volume load
metricDefinitions.formula: Sum of normalized external load in kilograms multiplied by completed repetitions for compatible load-and-repetition sets.
qualityRules: Exclude bodyweight-only, assistance, duration and distance modes
Never compare incompatible load scopes without warning

metricDefinitions.label: Estimated 1RM trend
metricDefinitions.formula: Consume the exact Phase 06 estimated-1RM method and method version; compare only the same canonical exercise and compatible equipment/load scope.

metricDefinitions.label: Personal records
metricDefinitions.formula: Count canonical Phase 06 personal-record events after rebuild using the active PR definition version.
qualityRules: A PR is not proof of long-term adaptation

metricDefinitions.label: Program adherence
metricDefinitions.formula: Completed scheduled sessions divided by scheduled sessions whose due date has passed for an active Phase 05 program instance.
qualityRules: Unavailable when no dated schedule exists
Do not infer missed sessions from program sequence alone

metricDefinitions.label: Days with nutrition entries
metricDefinitions.formula: Count local dates containing at least one non-deleted Phase 10 entry.
qualityRules: Does not imply a complete diary

metricDefinitions.label: Reviewed complete nutrition days
metricDefinitions.formula: Count dates explicitly marked complete-for-analysis by the user.

metricDefinitions.label: Average recorded energy
metricDefinitions.formula: Arithmetic mean of Phase 10 recorded energy totals on dates marked complete-for-analysis.

metricDefinitions.label: Average recorded macronutrient
metricDefinitions.formula: Arithmetic mean for the selected macronutrient on complete-for-analysis dates.
qualityRules: Do not reconstruct energy from macros

metricDefinitions.label: Difference from saved target
metricDefinitions.formula: Recorded daily value minus the frozen Phase 09 target snapshot for that date.

metricDefinitions.label: Nutrient data coverage
metricDefinitions.formula: Consume Phase 10 nutrient-coverage fields; aggregate numerator and denominator according to the same method version.

metricDefinitions.label: Median sleep duration
metricDefinitions.formula: Median Phase 12 calculated total-sleep duration for complete sleep records in range.
qualityRules: Diary and device-estimated sources remain labelled

metricDefinitions.label: Sleep schedule variability
metricDefinitions.formula: Method-versioned variability of selected clock-time feature after circular-time handling; exact method shown in UI.
qualityRules: Do not apply universal risk cutoff

metricDefinitions.label: Recovery dimension trend
metricDefinitions.formula: Median or distribution of one selected Phase 12 dimension such as energy, fatigue, stress, motivation or soreness.

metricDefinitions.label: Cardio duration
metricDefinitions.formula: Sum completed Phase 13 session duration for the selected modality or intensity classification.

metricDefinitions.label: Cardio distance
metricDefinitions.formula: Sum completed session distance after exact unit conversion, grouped by modality.

metricDefinitions.label: Pace trend
metricDefinitions.formula: Median pace for comparable completed sessions of the same modality and environment filter.

metricDefinitions.label: Recorded supplement-trial adherence
metricDefinitions.formula: Recorded scheduled intake events divided by user-entered planned events for one Phase 14 trial.
qualityRules: Unknown plan schedule makes metric unavailable

chartTypes.label: Raw values plus trend line
chartTypes.accessibility: Provide data table, point labels on focus and text summary.

chartTypes.label: Period totals
chartTypes.accessibility: Provide exact values and date range outside color encoding.

chartTypes.label: Distribution
chartTypes.accessibility: Provide median, range and record count in text.

chartTypes.label: Calendar presence
chartTypes.accessibility: Never use color alone; provide icons and list view.

chartTypes.label: Comparison table
chartTypes.accessibility: Use semantic headers and sortable-button labels.

chartTypes.label: Manual photo pair
chartTypes.accessibility: Provide dates, view labels and keyboard-operable selection; no image analysis.

dataQualityFlags.label: Value may be an input error
